question: Who among the following founded the Abhinav Bharat Mandir (Young India Society)?

options.text: Vinayak Damodar Savarkar and Ganesh Damodar Savarkar

solution:
The correct answer is __**Vinayak Damodar Savarkar and Ganesh Damodar Savarkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abhinav Bharat Mandir**, also known as the **Young India Society**, was founded by **Vinayak Damodar Savarkar** and his brother **Ganesh Damodar Savarkar** in **1904**.
 
• The organization aimed to promote revolutionary activities against British colonial rule in India and worked to inspire Indian youth to fight for independence.
 
• Abhinav Bharat Mandir was initially started as a secret society in **Nashik**, Maharashtra, and later expanded its influence across India. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• **Vinayak Damodar Savarkar**, also known as **Veer Savarkar**, was a prominent revolutionary, writer, and nationalist who played a significant role in India's freedom struggle.
 
• The society organized several revolutionary activities, including armed resistance against British rule, and inspired individuals to engage in acts of patriotism. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• It was disbanded later by the British authorities due to its involvement in revolutionary activities. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Vinayak Damodar Savarkar and Ganesh Damodar Savarkar.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vinayak Damodar Savarkar:**

 
 
• **Born:** 28 May 1883 in Nashik, Maharashtra, Savarkar was an influential revolutionary, writer, and nationalist leader.
 
• He advocated for armed resistance against British rule and inspired the youth to participate in the Indian independence movement.
 
• Savarkar also coined the term **Hindutva** and emphasized cultural and religious nationalism.
 
 
 
• **Ganesh Damodar Savarkar:**
 
 
• **Brother of Vinayak Savarkar:** Ganesh Damodar Savarkar was also actively involved in revolutionary activities and contributed to the formation of the Abhinav Bharat Mandir.
 
• He played a key role in organizing revolutionary actions and inspiring patriotism among Indian youth.
 
 
 
• **Abhinav Bharat Mandir:**
 
 
• The organization was secretive and aimed at mobilizing Indians to revolt against British colonial rule.
 
• It encouraged armed resistance and revolutionary activities to achieve independence.
 
• The British authorities disbanded the organization due to its involvement in revolutionary acts.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Role of Abhinav Bharat Mandir:**

 
 
• The society played a significant role in shaping revolutionary activities and inspiring patriotism among Indian youth.
 
• **Key Members:** Apart from the Savarkar brothers, the organization attracted numerous revolutionary leaders who contributed to India's independence struggle.
 
 
 
• **Legacy:**
 
 
• The efforts of Abhinav Bharat Mandir are remembered as a stepping stone in the Indian independence movement.
 
• The ideals and sacrifices of its members continue to inspire future generations in India.
